style.backgroundSystem: seamless cool white #FFFFFF for packshots, mist blue-grey #EEF2F7 for infographic screens, deep indigo #123A8F for the credential card; outdoor lifestyle frames graded to the same neutral key with a solid signal-red #E2202B arc band reserved for copy
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line markers and empty rounded seal outlines in one accent colour, no emblem or cross shapes
style.lightingSystem: bright even high-key studio light with a front key and soft fill, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars; lifestyle frames keep neutral daylight at 5500K with directional skimming or sweeping sun
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean clinical-ready household first-aid visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cool white #FFFFFF, mist blue-grey #EEF2F7, deep indigo #123A8F and one signal red accent #E2202B; neutral studio temperature with bright even high-key light, front key, soft fill and soft contact shadows, outdoor frames locked to neutral 5500K daylight; seamless white for packshots, mist blue-grey for infographic screens, deep indigo for the credential card and one solid signal-red arc band reserved for copy; modern geometric sans-serif with headline-only placeholder text; thin single-weight line markers and empty seal outlines only; stable straight-on 3/4 product angle and locked case scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no emblem or badge artwork, no invented numbers or credentials.
noDrift: no emblem, cross or badge artwork added to any surface
no numeric counts, prices or credential marks invented on screen
style.presentationRules: stable straight-on 3/4 read of the closed hard case across packshots, lid opens to a flat top-down reveal, product scale locked between shots so the case always reads the same size
style.surfaceSystem: matte white board and pale stone-grey counter #E4E7EA; outdoor surfaces read as matte natural ground and timber
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, headline-only copy held in placeholder slots, never dense body text
